description.narrative: UNICEF supported the Government of Nepal to develop child-centred and inclusive District Disaster Management Plans (DDRMPs) in two districts (Dhading and Dolakha) and reviewed 5 DDMPs in priority districts. Government officials and local representatives linked DDMPs contributed for their planning process for risk reduction at schools and communities. | Status:On-track | As-of Date:31/12/2017
